title: Mallok immutable Cloudflare provider-call evidence v1
description: One immutable request or terminal-result record for one provider call made while a D1 deployment barrier is active.

x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.canonicalBytes: Every record is canonical JSON encoded as UTF-8 with no BOM and a final LF. requestRecordHash is SHA-256 over the exact canonical request-record bytes excluding the final LF.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.fixedPath: The path is `.mallok/deployments/${lockId}/attempts/${sequence.toString().padStart(6, '0')}-${providerCallId}.${recordType}.json`. sequence is unique and strictly increasing within one lock; providerCallId is globally fresh UUID v4.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.writeOrder: The request record must be durably created with exclusive temp-file + fsync + atomic rename before the provider call. The matching result record may be created only after a terminal provider result and must reference the request hash. Existing records are immutable and must never be overwritten or appended in place.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.resultCorrelation: A result must have the same lockId, attemptId, providerCallId, sequence, operation, purpose, candidateInputHash, workerBundleHash, assetManifestHash, candidateInventoryHash, versionTag, providerMessage and optional targetVersionId as its request; requestRecordHash must equal SHA-256 of that exact request record. result.recordedAt must be at or after request.recordedAt. A result without one unique matching request is invalid.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.missingResult: A request without a matching result means local outcome unknown. Recovery must not infer failure from process exit or missing output; it may issue a journaled version-observation, then reissue the same effect-idempotent version upload or exact-version activation under the deployment protocol.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.attemptIdentity: For version-upload and version-observation, attemptId equals the current deployment_locks.version_upload_attempt_id and lockId equals the version operation id. For activation, attemptId equals deployment_locks.activation_attempt_id and lockId equals the activation operation id. Multiple provider calls that safely retry the same logical operation share attemptId but always use distinct providerCallId values.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.logicalAttemptImmutability: The runtime validates the complete per-lock journal as one aggregate, not records independently. Every request sharing one version-upload attemptId has purpose=deploy and identical candidateInputHash, workerBundleHash, assetManifestHash, candidateInventoryHash, versionTag and providerMessage; this equality applies across version-upload and version-observation records. Every request sharing one activation attemptId has identical purpose, all four hashes, versionTag, providerMessage and targetVersionId. Any reuse of a logical attempt with a changed candidate, message, purpose or target is invalid and must fail closed before a provider call; a retarget creates a fresh logical attemptId through the D1 state transition.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.secretBoundary: argv, token, secrets-file path or contents, account/database identifiers, response bodies and absolute filesystem paths are forbidden. providerMessage contains only the exact non-secret Mallok annotation frozen by CLOUDFLARE.md.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.providerCorrelation: For a successful activation, providerVersionId must equal targetVersionId. A successful version-observation serializes every matching provider version UUID exactly once in lowercase lexical order; providerVersionId is absent when that array is empty and otherwise equals its first (smallest) value. Provider version/deployment identifiers are canonical lowercase UUID values, but Mallok does not assume their UUID version bits.
